session.error.another_server: This browser is signed in at another server. Forget that server first, then sign in here.
session.error.attack_warning: Warning: the server shows something other than what this device has pinned for your account. This can be an attack. Nothing was opened. Do not try again on this network, and tell whoever runs the server.
session.error.bad_response: The server gave an answer Ferret does not understand. Try again later.
session.error.busy: Ferret is forgetting a server right now. Wait until that is done, then try again.
session.error.disconnected: Ferret's background stopped while it worked, and the vault is locked. Try again.
session.error.internal_error: Something went wrong in Ferret. Try again.
session.error.invalid_input: Something you typed is too long or not allowed.
session.error.kdf_profile_unknown: The server asks for password stretching this version of Ferret does not know. The sign-in was stopped.
session.error.malformed_setup_qr: That is not the text of an emergency sheet's QR code. Copy the whole line that starts with ferret-setup: from page 1 of the sheet.
session.error.methods_invalid: The server gave an unlock method list Ferret cannot use. The sign-in was stopped.
session.error.network: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
session.error.not_available: Ferret cannot do that in this version.
session.error.permission_needed: Ferret has no permission to talk to this server yet. Give it on the sign-in page.
session.error.permission_refused: Without permission to talk to this server, Ferret cannot sign in. Nothing was sent. Give the permission to go on.
session.error.pinned_elsewhere: This account is already known on this device under another server address. Nothing was saved.
session.error.pinned_sk_bit: The secret key answer does not match what this device has pinned for this account. Either you answered differently the first time, or the server is lying. The sign-in was stopped; it is not a wrong password.
session.error.qr_account: Warning: the server named another account than the one on your emergency sheet. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped and nothing was saved.
session.error.qr_profile: Warning: the server asks for weaker password stretching than your emergency sheet states. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped before the password was stretched.
session.error.qr_server_key: Warning: the server proved a different identity than the one on your emergency sheet. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped before it was finished, and nothing was saved.
session.error.qr_server_url: The emergency sheet is for another server address than the one you typed. Nothing was sent.
session.error.qr_sk_bit: Your emergency sheet and your answer disagree about whether the account has a secret key. Nothing was sent.
session.error.qr_too_large: That text is too long to be the text of an emergency sheet's QR code.
session.error.qr_unsupported: This emergency sheet is from a newer version than Ferret understands.
session.error.quota_exceeded: This account has the most devices it may have. Forget old devices in the web vault, then try again.
session.error.server_invalid: That is not a server address Ferret can use. Type the address of your vault, for example https://vault.example.com.
session.error.server_not_https: Ferret talks to a server over https only. Type the https address of your vault.
session.error.server_reserved: That name is reserved for tests and is never a real server.
session.error.signed_out: This device is no longer signed in. Sign in again in the sign-in tab.
session.error.sk_answer_required: Say whether this account has a secret key.
session.error.sk_required: Enter the secret key from your emergency sheet.
session.error.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
session.error.two_factor_unsupported: This account has two-factor sign-in turned on. Ferret cannot sign in with a second factor in this version.
session.error.vault_locked: The vault was locked while Ferret worked. Try again.
session.error.worker_failed: The part of Ferret that holds your keys stopped. Try again.
session.error.wrong_credentials: The vault could not be opened. Check the e-mail, the master password and the secret key.
session.grant.hint: Check that this is your server. Firefox then asks whether Ferret may talk to it; Ferret talks to no other site.
session.open.hint: You can close this tab and use Ferret from the toolbar.
session.open.title: The vault is open
session.popup.open_hint: The list of your vault comes in a later version of Ferret.
session.popup.signed_out_hint: Sign in to your own Ferret server in a tab. Firefox asks for the server's permission there.
session.qr.hint: The text holds no key. It pins your server, your account and the server's key before you sign in.
session.qr.label: Text of the QR code (optional)
session.qr.summary: Have your emergency sheet? Paste the text of its QR code
session.qr.tofu: Without the sheet, this first sign-in trusts that the server is the one it says it is (trust on first use). Later sign-ins on this device check it.
session.server.hint: Ferret talks to your server over https only.
session.server.intro: Type the address of your Ferret server.
session.server.label: Server address
session.signin.title: Sign in to Ferret
session.sk.question: Does this account have a secret key?
session.sk.question_hint: It is on your emergency sheet and starts with FFS1-.
session.sk.remember: Remember the secret key on this device
session.sk.remember_hint: Otherwise you type it each time you unlock.
session.unlock.title: Unlock the vault
